senses.gloss:
ITA-5.69.6 yonikandaḥ योनिकन्दः
Round-shaped abscess in vagina
A gynaecological disorder characterized by a tuberous swelling filled with pus; a tuberous swelling filled with blood; a tuberous swelling resembling a nikuca fruit.

ITA-9.2.103 yoni kalkadhāraṇa योनिकल्कधारण
Retention of medicated pastes in vagina
Application and retention of a medicated paste or poultice in the vaginal canal.

ITA-9.2.100 yoni dhūpana योनिधूपन
Vaginal fumigation
The procedure of fumigating the external genitalia or vaginal canal with fumes produced by medicinal substances.

ITA-9.2.98 yoni picu योनिपिचु
Vaginal tampon
A sterile tampon soaked with medicated liquids which is inserted in the vaginal canal.

ITA-9.2.99 yoni pūraṇa योनिपूरण
Vaginal irrigation
The procedure of introducing medicated substances into the vaginal canal.

ITA-9.2.97 yoni dhāvana/ yoni prakṣālana योनिधावन/ योनिप्रक्षालन
Vaginal douche
The procedure of vaginal douching with medicated liquids.

ITA-9.2.102 yoni lepana योनिलेपन
Application of medicated paste to vagina
Application of a medicated paste to the vaginal walls.

ITA-9.2.101 yoni vartī योनिवर्ति
Vaginal suppository or wick
The procedure of inserting a medicated suppository or wick prepared with herbal or mineral medicationsinto the vagina.

ITA-5.69.1 yonirogaḥ/ yonivyāpat योनिरोगः/योनिव्यापत्
Vaginal disease
Disorders of female genitalia including the uterus.
